---
title: "Introduction"
order: 1
---

This module introduces the basic building blocks of a course content page. You can combine headings, paragraphs, lists, and text formatting to organise information and make it easier for participants to follow.

The examples in this module show how to structure a topic page and present information clearly. Browse the topics to see how each element looks when rendered, and copy the examples you would like to use in your own course.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you will know how to:

- Organise a page using headings and paragraphs.
- Format text using bold and italic styles.
- Create bulleted and numbered lists.
- Structure a topic page so that it is easy to read and navigate.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Getting started

You do not need to write Markdown from scratch. Find an example that suits your needs, copy the code snippet, and replace the demonstration text with your own.
:::

## In this module

- **Topic 1 – Structuring a page:** Headings, paragraphs, text formatting, and lists.
- **Topic 2 – More ways to organise content:** Examples of additional page elements and formatting.
- **Topic 3 – Putting it together:** A practical example of combining content elements on a page.
